totals.sum_scope: Explicit closed outer elapsed receipts, including failures. Nested timings are not added. Concurrent intervals are not subtracted. This is not CPU/GPU utilization or a host census.

collector_receipt_contents.timing_scope: From before source/spec reads through child exit, ledger verification and cleanup; final receipt write and enclosing tool overhead excluded.

governing_document_append_provenance.scope: Observed append and retained before/after only; unrelated concurrent changes are not attributed to this increment.
Observed append and retained before/after only; unrelated concurrent changes are not attributed to this increment.

host_expiry.scope: One public default-clock host UID1000 control; no Docker/broker/UID1001/native ACK expiry transfer.

original_capture_before_map.provenance: Full original capture before native execution; no new host tests.

review_facts.ACK_drop: Only broker-thread isolated actual_isolated_birth_ack invokes original real parser on recv-only tee; retains original header/body and live kernel witnesses before application exception. No packet-loss, synthetic frame, successful broker ACK-consumption or supplied lease claim.
review_facts.authority: Original default real clock, full8tuple/token/completion guards and SQL transaction/process locks remain unchanged, strict5000ms ACK admission unchanged; original95s client and Docker resource limits unchanged.
review_facts.callback_error: Runs original genuine isolated close_handoff inside original native transaction, retains immutable native lease and decoded original validated result plus actual kernel witnesses, writes explicitly owner-UID1000 marker, then deliberately raises before guard postcheck/release. Raw wire ACK is not observed and remains null.
review_facts.cleanup: Allocation map initialized before START; post-control preSTOP helper/event errors are caught so native STOP is attempted. Runtime close and hook restoration run in nested finally after STOP. Actual STOP/kernel birth disappearance/socket/resource assertions must be established by future matched native execution.
review_facts.completion: Actual task, execution attempt, coordinator completion rows and raw Portal body receipt/operation retained. Legitimate database_attempt_admitted receipt is distinct from database_complete. Literal operation absence is not proof that an arbitrary unknown receipt is valid. Canonical no-publication separately checked.
review_facts.effects: External owner marker and actual worktree status/diff/file bytes retained; UNKNOWN settlement does not imply no effects, child never entered, or general callback rollback. Live worktree retention explicitly does not claim an atomic snapshot or write-origin attestation.
review_facts.original_cases: Existing helper/class AST definitions unchanged; run/main additions reviewed and original positive/prebirth routes retained. Source review is not a runtime regression-test claim.
review_facts.raw_native_rows: Before-guard coordination export and after-STOP closed coordination/execution schemas/tables/indexes precede control summaries. Active control SQL is deliberately not reentered; owner cold reader must export the full third control DB after fixture closure.
